front.title: Extended IP mobility procedures for EVPN-IRB

abstract.t: [RFC9721] introduces IP mobility procedures for EVPN-IRB that couple IP and MAC mobility sequence numbers. This coupling results in excessive control plane churn when a single IP migrates among multiple IP addresses associated with a single MAC address. This document proposes separating sequence number spaces for IP mobility (MAC-IP routes) and MAC mobility (MAC-only routes), reducing BGP updates from O(N) to O(1) when one IP moves among N IPs on a MAC, while maintaining full compatibility with an implementation conforming to the recommendations of [RFC9721]. Further, this document proposes an upgrade path for deployments transitioning to IP mobility as defined in [RFC9721] or this draft.
